verdict.rationale: three.js is a client-side JavaScript 3D rendering library distributed via npm. It has no hosted service, account system, or API that would issue credentials, so scoped or least-privilege API credentials for agents is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any credential capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
